mechanism: Armodafinil may potentiate the sympathomimetic and stimulant effects of phenelzine, and phenelzine inhibits CYP3A4/CYP2D6 metabolism of armodafinil, increasing CNS stimulation and hypertensive risk.
action: Avoid concurrent use or monitor closely for hypertension, tachycardia, agitation, and serotonergic symptoms; if necessary, use lowest doses with careful cardiovascular monitoring.
